name: Vaniville Area
description: The quiet southern start of Kalos around Vaniville Town and Aquacorde, spanning the first routes, Santalune Forest, and Santalune City.

name: Lumiose Area
description: The dazzling central metropolis of Lumiose City and the flower-lined routes that radiate from its boulevards.

name: Cyllage Area
description: The breezy western coast around Cyllage City, from the fossil cliffs of Route 8 to the sparkling Glittering Cave.

name: Shalour Area
description: The seaside city of Shalour and its Tower of Mastery, reached through the mirrored halls of Reflection Cave.

name: Coumarine Area
description: The terraced port of Coumarine City, the orchard road of Route 12, and the drifting currents of Azure Bay.

name: Laverre Area
description: The misty fairy-tale town of Laverre, the swampy Routes 14 and 15, and the humming Poké Ball Factory.

name: Anistar Area
description: The sundial city of Anistar in the frosted east, past the windswept Route 16 and the deep tunnels of Terminus Cave.

name: Snowbelle Area
description: The snowbound south around Snowbelle City, the freezing Frost Cavern, and the final climb of Victory Road.
